name: bello
description: Choose and run local Bello supervisor/coder workflows from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Choose configs and delegate tasks to Bello.
interface.longDescription: Inspects a task and user constraints to recommend one task-appropriate Bello configuration, optionally separates planning from execution, runs the locally installed Bello binary, monitors .supervisor state files, reports progress in Codex, and summarizes final code changes.
defaultPrompt: Run this task through Bello with supervisor/coder and keep me updated.
Recommend one Bello configuration for TASK.md and decide whether a separate planning pass would improve the result.
